0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards (4-6, 2-4 on the road, ninth in the East and 2.5 games back in the Southeast) visit the Detroit Pistons (6-3, first in the Central, third in the East), who have lost their last two games, while Washington is on a three-game losing streak. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision, while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Wizards lost 1-3 to the Pistons in the 2025-26 season series, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19, 2026.
